Agent tools
Agent tools
Moderne Agent Tools: Trading GPU for CPU

Deterministic, code-aware tools do the heavy lifting on cheap CPU — so coding agents reason over precomputed structure instead of burning expensive GPU tokens re-deriving it on every step.

13.5x
faster type-aware code search vs. grep at enterprise scale
4x
more accurate agent edits with LST context
30K
repositories indexed in a single workspace
65M+
methods searchable in sub-second time
30%
lower token spend per agent task
Faster reasoning. Less token spend. Better AI results.

Why Moderne Prethink changes the game for agents

Prethink feeds agents whole-repository context grounded in real code structure — so they stop guessing and start acting on what the codebase actually is.
